**Who Invented the Python Programming Language?**

The Python programming language was invented by **Guido van Rossum**. He began working on Python in the late 1980s as a successor to the ABC programming language. **What University Did Guido van Rossum Study At?**

Guido van Rossum studied at the **University of Amsterdam**, where he earned his degree in computer science. During his studies, computer science was part of the mathematics department at the university. Additionally, he took computer science classes at **Vrije Universiteit** under an arrangement that allowed students to attend courses at either institution.

### Summary

- **Inventor**: Guido van Rossum
- **University**: University of Amsterdam (with additional classes at Vrije Universiteit)
